name: Kataribe Partners
description: Kataribe Partners is a calm, longform landing WordPress theme designed for public-relations agencies and sector communication studios. Built around a horizontal-strip archetype with high-key documentary photography and clean sans typography, it presents structured coverage weeks, transparent retainers, and live coverage logs. Features five-language compatibility, a short top menu to the inner pages and in-page anchors on the home page, and a single repeated call to action to request a proposal.
